# SQLite

Sunrise vendors the official SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation (`sqlite3.c` and
`sqlite3.h`) from `sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip` published at
https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip.

Upstream release date: 2026-07-24.
Upstream source id:
`2026-07-24 19:02:57 bf7c7f30031888f4e796e429ab3978879485813aaca6f641c7b33e4e09459bcc`.
Verified archive SHA3-256:
`628a44cfe82c66aed1ccbbe85a562d2e33ebe64b3288981ed76285612227934e`.

SQLite is dedicated to the public domain. No separate runtime installation is
required; the amalgamation is compiled into Sunrise.
